aspect: Access is given willingly and early
description: Help with banking begins as genuine assistance and does not have a moment at which it becomes something else.
energy_note: No day on which it started.

aspect: Reporting means accusing your own child
description: The victim must name a son or daughter to the police, or to the bank, and most do not.
energy_note: The complaint costs her the family.

description: 'I'll do the online banking, you shouldn't have to worry about it.' He does. He also moves £400 a month into his own account and calls it his time. When she asks he is wounded, and reminds her who takes her to appointments.
energy_note: Wounded that she asked, and she apologises.

description: Where capacity is in question, consent becomes arguable, and the arguability is frequently the reason the case ends.
energy_note: She cannot reliably say she did not agree.
